subject: Vendor onboarding: Cardinal Data — no-PO governance proposal
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@cardinaldata.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Cardinal Data Procurement <procurement@cardinaldata.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: [Cardinal Data] Request: streamlined onboarding (no-PO for low-dollar monthly)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Cardinal Data would like to move forward with a pilot subscription for your hosted API (team plan, small usage). Our procurement org typically requires a PO for formal contracts, but for small monthly SaaS charges under $2k we try to avoid POs to speed up onboarding.

Can Redwood consider a time-limited no-PO path for this pilot? We can provide evidence (company registration, SOC 2 summary, paid card) and sign any attestation you need. We're targeting a July 1 start.

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships
Cardinal Data

Attachments: Cardinal_Risk_Form.pdf (pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cardinaldata.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Cardinal Data] Request: streamlined onboarding (no-PO for low-dollar monthly)

Hi Elena — great to hear and glad the demo was useful. We're open to short-term exceptions for small-dollar pilots but need a documented approval path and evidence checklist on file.

Proposed approach: 
- 90-day trial with no PO required, capped at $2,000/month
- Vendor evidence package submitted and retained (company docs, SOC 2 summary, PCI/commercial card ok)
- Procurement approval from Redwood (Karthik) + finance acknowledgement
- Auto-convert to normal PO flow after the trial unless both sides sign a longer-term MSA with payment terms

Can you confirm you can provide the evidence this week? I'll loop Karthik to outline the required checklist and a one-pager approval note.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@cardinaldata.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Cardinal Data] Request: streamlined onboarding (no-PO for low-dollar monthly)

Vanessa / Elena — quick notes from procurement side: we can approve a temporary no-PO corridor for a pilot but require a few items to mitigate risk. Proposed minimum checklist (to be completed before waiver):
1) Completed vendor risk form (we received a draft from Elena)
2) SOC 2 Type II attestation or equivalent summary (redacted ok)
3) W-9 or international equivalent + company registration details
4) Payment method on file (corporate card or ACH instructions)
5) Single-user contact and support escalation path documented

If all items are present we can sign a 90-day no-PO exception with the following controls: spend cap at $2,000/mo, monthly reconciliation invoices, and procurement reserve right to require PO at any time with 30 days' notice.

I'll prepare a short approval memo and route it through finance for sign-off. Elena, please upload the completed forms to the Drive link Vanessa shared.

-Karthik
VP, Procurement
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_vendor_evidence_20250610.zip (zip)
From: Elena Rossi <elena@cardinaldata.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Cardinal Data] Request: streamlined onboarding (no-PO for low-dollar monthly)

Thanks Karthik — attached is our completed Cardinal_Risk_Form.pdf and a zipped packet with the supporting docs. SOC 2 summary and company registration included; payment will be via corporate card. We confirmed the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-cardinal-onboard-evidence

A couple of quick asks from our side: 
- Can the 90-day exception include an explicit MX policy for data retention (we require 12 months retention for logs)?
- If we need to switch to PO mid-trial, can Redwood provide a short lead time so auto-billing doesn't interrupt access?

Happy to sign any short attestation. Let me know if you want to hop on a 15-min call today.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: Cardinal_Risk_Form.pdf (pdf), vendor_documents.zip (zip)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cardinaldata.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Cardinal Data] Request: streamlined onboarding (no-PO for low-dollar monthly)

All — thanks for turning these around quickly. Procurement (Karthik) has reviewed the packet and finance gave a conditional OK. Summary of outcome and next steps: 

Decision: APPROVED — 90-day no-PO exception for Cardinal Data (start date: 2025-07-01)
Controls and notes: 
- Spend cap: $2,000 / month; billing via card on file; monthly reconciliation required
- Data retention: Redwood will honor Cardinal's request for 12-month log retention; will document in the attestation
- Convert to PO: Procurement may request PO with 30 days' notice; Redwood will email the billing contact and pause auto-billing only after the notice period
- Approval memo: Karthik will circulate a memo for internal records (procurement code: NOPO-2025-06-CARD)

Action items: 
1) Elena: confirm the billing card and primary invoice contact in the Drive folder (due 2025-06-16)
2) Karthik: send internal approval memo and flag finance for monitoring (due 2025-06-13)
3) Marissa: prepare a one-line onboarding note and entitlement in the Console so Cardinal gets trial access on 2025-07-01

Thanks — I will also send the DocuSign attestation link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123-cardinal-no-po-exception

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
